name: Kirisaki Asahi
source:
He has been assigned to help run a public bathhouse while his grandmother is away.
Although he is dressed as a woman, he is a boy.
He is serious and caring, and cannot leave anyone in trouble. On the other hand, he is a little sensitive.
His parents are overseas and he lives with his older sister. He takes care of the household chores in place of his older sister.

When he hears that his grandmother's bathhouse is no longer able to continue running, he takes it upon herself to do something about it.

He has a crush on Chika, a part-time worker he meets at the bathhouse.
However, he feels he cannot express his feelings to her because he is dressed as a woman.
